title: Railway RRB Technician CEN.No 02/2025 DV Admit Card 2026
intro: Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (Ministry of Railway) has release the DV Admit Card for the post of Technician Grade-I & Grade-III (CEN No. 02/2025) on its official website. This recruitment was conducted for a total of 6,238 posts. The application process for RRB Technician Grade-I & Grade-III Recruitment 2025 was carried out from 28 June 2025 to 07 August 2025. The CBT examination was conducted from 06 to 13 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Railway RRB Technician Gr-III DV Admit Card 2026 from the link provided below.
applicationFee: Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
OBC / EWS / SC / ST / PH : Rs. 250/-
Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
